questions.q: MCB Bank was formerly known as ___
questions.explanation: MCB originally stood for Muslim Commercial Bank before it was privatised.

questions.q: Which type of bank account is best suited for daily business transactions?
questions.explanation: Current accounts allow frequent deposits and withdrawals without interest, suiting businesses.

questions.q: A bank's main source of profit is ___
questions.explanation: Banks earn mainly by lending deposits at higher interest than they pay to depositors.
PIN (Personal Identification Number) secures ATM and card transactions.

questions.q: A loan given against property as security is called a ___
questions.explanation: A mortgage is a loan secured against immovable property.

questions.q: A demand draft is best described as ___
questions.explanation: A demand draft is prepaid, so the bank guarantees payment to the recipient.

questions.q: Deposit protection in Pakistan is provided through the ___
questions.explanation: The Pakistan Deposit Protection Corporation insures bank deposits up to a set limit.

questions.q: Internet banking mainly allows customers to ___
questions.explanation: Internet banking lets customers transfer funds and manage accounts online.

questions.q: The rate at which the State Bank lends to commercial banks is called the ___
questions.explanation: The policy rate is the SBP's key lending rate and anchors market interest rates.
A bank statement lists all deposits, withdrawals and charges in an account over a period.
